summary: A bounded provider and two independently scoped consumers.

work_product.architecture: Extend the existing Payload value in provider.go with a Value string field. Existing consumers use that public field; unrelated behavior is unchanged.
design_decisions: Provider defines the public field once; consumers do not edit provider files.
assumptions: provider.go, consumer.go and observer.go already exist.

tasks.title: Provider value
tasks.description: Extend the existing Payload struct in provider.go with Value string. Add provider tests; do not edit consumers. This is an existing-file modification, not a new declaration manifest.
acceptance_criteria: Payload exposes Value string and provider tests pass.

tasks.title: Primary consumer
tasks.description: Update existing Consume(Payload) string in consumer.go to return the provider's Value field; add consumer tests. This needs the provider's source field. Do not edit provider.go.
acceptance_criteria: Consume returns Payload.Value and consumer tests pass.

tasks.title: Independent observer
tasks.description: Update existing Observe(Payload) string in observer.go to return the provider's Value field; add observer tests. Preserve its existing dependency on task 0. Do not edit provider.go or consumer.go.
acceptance_criteria: Observe returns Payload.Value and observer tests pass.
